prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1093; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be called the claimant on this, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on the main road in Baytown, in the right lane, heading toward the highway on-ramp.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to move over to the left. I checked my mirror and I didn't see anyone, so I signaled and started to move.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not really. I felt a bump on my side and heard scraping. When I looked, the other car was right next to me and had already come into my lane.
Q: What was the speed of your vehicle at the time?
A: I'd guess around thirty-five miles an hour. Traffic was moving steadily.
Q: Were you able to stop or pull over after the contact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. My car was drivable, but the side mirror was knocked off.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: Yes. I went to urgent care the same day because my neck was stiff and I had a headache. They said it looked like whiplash.
Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?
A: Yes, my neck still hurts when I turn my head, and I get pain across my shoulders. Sitting for long periods makes it worse.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and signaled. I just want my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
